fields.reasoning: The built code already does this, and the run's first session is the first thing of the run with a pane, so anchoring on it needs no window owned by daemonStart and keeps every session of one run, whatever its change set, side by side.
fields.statement: A run's panes live in one window per run: the window holding the run's first session with a pane (paneAnchor in internal/api/run_leaves.go). Each later session of the run splits that session's tab, or its step anchor's tab when that has a record. Not the window rhiza run start (daemonStart) opens, and not one window per change set; the run's first session opens the window.
